assessment.checks: Exact observer/instant/source and completed output; present consequence requires actual consequence SEM experience; source signal matches goal definition
assessment.operands: Exactly one recalled Before in same observed context, otherwise missing baseline; current safe After sample; no full historical experience/archive lookup
assessment.reads: Settled goal state only; lifecycle-coincident reads excluded in first profile

attribution.checks: Exact target original/instant/run/observer; only completed winning payloads; no unselected memory reload
attribution.operands: Narrow retained contexts group exactly four trials; one focal After identifies focal stroke and surviving event endpoint; no authored trial pairing or supplied focal child
attribution.unavailable: Missing/ambiguous grouping or insufficient recalled operands yields Unavailable with no invented target; actual semantic consumption remains separate from validation

significance.checks: Same observer/projected subject/consequence; qualification remains its actual assessed instant, attribution remains its actual evaluation instant
significance.operands: Narrow qualification plus actual attributed target only; no historical metric evidence or current goal reappraisal

binding.completion: Last producer may emit join as direct parent; every other parent already completed. Exact allocated child/input association is checked at ingress before PRJ/read.
binding.future: Consumer-specific target-original/instant/event type bound in admitted model; strictly later source instant; no delivery reuse
binding.transaction: Candidate delivery consumption and output facts roll back with whole instant; no unresolved expected target at successful commit
binding.restore: Independent complete-prefix replay with exact pending queue; no private-cache certificate

scope.assessmentAbsence: Completed absence dispatch allocates no assessment; explicit absent focal/qualification deliveries still complete. No goal read, attribution calculation/result allocation or significance owner occurs without a consequence. Delivery failure still rejects.
scope.assessmentLearning: Baseline recall and assessment do not create use/presentation credit.
scope.attributionUse: Only actual consumed child addresses reach use owner, including lawful partial consumption on Unavailable.
scope.bodyTarget: Body operands may earn use but cannot become the focal event target.
scope.qualification: Both determinate directions qualify; withdrawn later goal does not revise the frozen carry.
scope.owner: Current target survival is checked against owner batch; writes only use/directional metadata, never payload/acquisition time.

work.meaning: Local maxima: attribution includes focal delivery plus evaluation/dispatch/use owner; significance includes original, two deliveries, join and owner; source/recall/other participants counted separately.

absence.source: Actual completed consequence sensing with no SEM reservation/experience; no replacement observation
absence.delivery: Both receiving targets get explicit absence envelopes with the actual SourceAt. Missing expected envelope remains an error.
absence.attribution: Absent focus yields no attribution result or use dispatch; actual recall remains independently lawful.
absence.significance: Absent qualification iff absent focal/result branch in this first profile; inconsistent mixtures reject. Both deliveries are consumed; no joined result/owner operation.
absence.identities: No experience, assessment or attribution occurrence is allocated to stand for absence.
